description: Read the user's graph view. `entity` selects which projection: 'user' (the user's self-graph), 'cosmos' (the cosmos entity's view of them), or 'polarity' (the dyadic synchronization between the two). Use 'user' for general questions about what the user thinks, does, or knows. Use 'polarity' when comparing the user's self-image against the system's observation.
name: polarity_get_graph
